query: WITH locked AS ( SELECT s.id FROM run_step s JOIN run r ON r.id = s.run_id WHERE s.id = $1 AND s.status = 'done' AND s.branch IS NULL AND r.lease_owner IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3 FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF s FOR SHARE OF r) UPDATE run_step SET branch = $2 FROM locked WHERE run_step.id = locked.id AND run_step.branch IS NULL
